3. The strait that separates European Turkey from Asian Turkey is the Bosphorus.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 2, 3.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The rock-hewn churches of Lalibela are located in Ethiopia.
2. The Kremlin is located in Rio de Janeiro.
3. The temple complex of Angkor Wat is located in Cambodia.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 1, 3.

q.q: Doha is the capital of:
q.e: Doha is the capital of Qatar.

q.q: Which of the following is a country through which the Prime Meridian passes?
q.e: Mali is a country through which the Prime Meridian passes.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The winds blowing between 40 and 50 degrees south are called the Mistral.
2. The cold wind of the Adriatic coast is the Sirocco.
3. The instrument that records earthquake waves is the Seismograph.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 3.

q.q: The highest mountain outside Asia is:
q.e: The highest mountain outside Asia is Aconcagua.

q.q: The 'Roof of the World' is the:
q.e: The 'Roof of the World' is the Pamir Plateau.

q.q: Siam is the old name of:
q.e: Siam is the old name of Thailand.

q.q: Which of the following is a landlocked country?
q.e: Chad is a landlocked country.

q.q: The river that drains into the Adriatic Sea is the:
q.e: The river that drains into the Adriatic Sea is the Po.

q.q: Which of the following is NOT a country crossed by the Equator?
q.e: Peru is not a country crossed by the Equator.

q.q: The Lira is the currency of:
q.e: The Lira is the currency of Turkey.

q.q: The ancient city of Pompeii is located in:
q.e: The ancient city of Pompeii is located in Italy.

q.q: The smallest number which leaves a remainder of 1 when divided by 4, 12 and 18, and is exactly divisible by 13, is:
q.e: x = 36m + 1; choose the least m with x divisible by 13: 325.

q.q: A boat's speed in still water is 20 km/h and the stream flows at 4 km/h. It goes a certain distance downstream and returns to the starting point in 5 hours. What is that one-way distance (km)?
A vessel holds 64 litres of pure milk. 16 litres are drawn off and replaced by water; the process is repeated 2 times in all. How many litres of water does the vessel then contain?
Find the compound interest on Rs 8000 for 1 year at 20% per annum compounded half-yearly.
A bag contains 3 red, 3 blue and 5 green balls. Three balls are drawn at random without replacement. The probability that one ball of each colour is drawn is:
Two circles of radii 2 cm and 7 cm have their centres 41 cm apart. The length of a transverse (internal) common tangent is:
q.e: √(d² − (r₁+r₂)²) = 40 cm.

q.q: A, B and C can finish a job alone in 15, 12 and 20 days respectively. They start together, but C leaves after 2 days. In how many days in all is the job completed?
q.e: Work in 2 days = 0.4; remaining by A and B at 0.15/day takes 4 days; total 6.

q.q: Three runners take 24, 20 and 60 minutes respectively to complete one round of a circular track. If they start together from the same point in the same direction, after how many minutes will they next be together at the starting point?
Find the sum to infinity of the geometric series 12 + 9 + 6.75 + …

The table gives the production (in thousand tonnes) of three crops.
Crop | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022
Wheat | 80 | 140 | 40 | 50
Rice | 100 | 170 | 90 | 160
Maize | 50 | 60 | 180 | 130
The ratio of the total production of all three crops in 2022 to that in 2019 is:
In an examination, section A of 20 students averaged 42 marks and section B of 30 students averaged 61. The combined average is:
q.e: Weighted mean = 53.4.

q.q: What is the remainder when 5^250 is divided by 7?
q.e: Use the cycle of 5^k mod 7: 5^250 ≡ 2.

q.q: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 20 and 10 hours respectively. They are opened alternately for one hour each, A first. How many hours does it take to fill the empty tank?
q.e: Per two-hour cycle 0.15 of the tank is filled; the last part is completed by A (and B if needed): total 13.5 h.

q.q: The population of a town is 200000. In successive years it increases by 10%, decreases by 20%, increases by 10% (in that order) over 3 years. The population at the end is:
q.e: Apply the factors in order: result 193600.

q.q: 7 persons Ali, Bilal, Faraz, Kamran, Mariam, Mehwish, Sadia live on 7 different floors of a building, numbered 1 (ground) to 7 (top), one person per floor. Faraz lives on the floor immediately below Bilal. Exactly 2 floors lie between the floors of Sadia and Faraz. Exactly 2 floors lie between the floors of Faraz and Mehwish. Mariam lives on the floor immediately below Faraz. Exactly 4 floors lie between the floors of Kamran and Mehwish. Exactly 3 floors lie between the floors of Mehwish and Mariam. Who lives on floor 3?
q.e: Place the definite clues first (immediate neighbours, ends), then use the 'between' and 'left of' clues to fix the rest; the arrangement is unique.

q.q: What comes next? H, O, I, N, J, M, ?
q.e: Two interleaved series: +1 from H, and −1 from O.

q.q: After 2 o'clock, the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock coincide for the first time at how many minutes past 2?
Statement: S < X = Y ≥ P > U < T. Conclusions: I. U = S  II. T ≥ P  III. X ≤ Y. Which of the conclusions is/are definitely true?
o: Only II and III are true
q.e: A conclusion is definitely true only if it holds for every set of values consistent with the whole chain.

q.q: If '+' means '×', '−' means '−', '×' means '+', '÷' means '÷', then the value of 19 − 4 × 3 + 8 is:
q.e: Replace each sign by its meaning: 19 − 4 + 3 × 8 = 39 (BODMAS applies).

q.q: Statements: Some pens are trees. All trees are roses. No bag is a rose. Conclusions: I. All bags are pens.  II. All pens are bags.  III. Some trees are pens.  IV. Some pens are not roses. Which of the conclusions definitely follow(s)?
o: Only I, II and III follow
Only II, III and IV follow
q.e: Draw all possible Venn diagrams for the three statements; a conclusion follows only if it holds in every one of them.

q.q: In a certain code, HOLD is written as 54 and PACK is written as 32. How will PLANT be written in that code?
q.e: The code is the sum of the positions of the vowels doubled plus the sum of the positions of the consonants; PLANT → 64.

q.q: In the word PLATFORM, how many pairs of letters are there such that the number of letters between them in the word equals the number of letters between them in the alphabet?
q.e: Check every pair; 1 satisfy the condition.

q.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 4, 18, 30, 67, 128, 219, 346
q.e: The correct series (nth term = n³ + 3) has 11 in place of 18.

q.q: Maria is 21st from the top in a class of 36. After Maria and Noor exchange ranks, Maria is 25th from the top. What is Noor's original rank from the bottom?
q.e: Noor was originally 25th from the top, i.e. 36+1−25 from the bottom.

q.q: Farah is the daughter of Kiran. Kiran is the son of Shazia. Shazia is the mother of Omar. Omar is the son of Bilal. Bilal is the father of Nida. How is Farah related to Nida?
q.e: Work through the chain link by link, assuming the usual convention that a couple's children are common to both.

q.q: A cyclist starts from a point and goes 4 m towards the west, then turns right and goes 12 m, then turns right and goes 6 m, then turns right and goes 12 m. How far, and in which direction, is he now from the starting point?
o: 2 m north-west of the starting point
2 m east of the starting point
4 m east of the starting point
2 m south-east of the starting point
q.e: Coordinates of the end point (E,N) = (2, 0); distance = √(2²+0²) = 2 m, direction east.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The architecture with separate memories for instructions and data is the RISC architecture.
2. The processor design with a large set of complex instructions is called CISC.
3. The anomaly in which more frames cause more page faults, seen in FIFO, is Shell anomaly.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 2.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Google Chrome was released in 2008.
2. The JavaScript language was created by Brendan Eich.
3. The research laboratory where the graphical user interface and Ethernet were developed was National Center for Supercomputing Applications.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 1, 2.

q.q: Microsoft was founded in 1975 by Bill Gates and:
q.e: Microsoft was founded in 1975 by Bill Gates and Paul Allen.

q.q: In the Fibonacci sequence with F(0) = 0 and F(1) = 1, the value of F(6) is:
The group of SQL commands such as INSERT and UPDATE is called:
q.e: The group of SQL commands such as INSERT and UPDATE is called DML.

q.q: The full form of PNG is:
q.e: The full form of PNG is Portable Network Graphics.

q.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The number of bits in an IPv4 address is 32.
2. The protocol used by the ping command is ICMP.
3. The network spanning a small area such as a building is called a LAN.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
q.e: Statements marked correct: 1, 2, 3.

q.q: The cloud deployment model in which services are offered over the internet to many customers by a provider is the ___ cloud.
q.e: A public cloud is shared among many customers.

q.q: Uniform Resource Locator is the full form of:
q.e: Uniform Resource Locator is the full form of URL.

q.q: The full form of EEPROM is:
q.e: The full form of EEPROM is Electrically Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory.

q.q: Which of the following is an object-oriented programming language?
q.e: Java is an object-oriented programming language.

q.q: Which of the following is NOT a raster image file format?
q.e: .xlsx is not a raster image file format.
